# Lab 23.13: Stream Logs to Pub/Sub for a SIEM

## What We Are Going to Do
Send audit logs from the organization to a Pub/Sub topic, and read them as a SIEM connector would.

## Steps

1. **Create a topic and a subscription.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub topics create siem-logs --project=LOG_PROJECT_ID
gcloud pubsub subscriptions create siem-sub --topic=siem-logs --project=LOG_PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create an aggregated sink to the topic.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud logging sinks create org-to-siem \
  pubsub.googleapis.com/projects/LOG_PROJECT_ID/topics/siem-logs \
  --organization=ORG_ID --include-children \
  --log-filter='logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com" OR severity&gt;=ERROR'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Grant the writer identity publish rights.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud pubsub topics add-iam-policy-binding siem-logs --project=LOG_PROJECT_ID \
  --member="WRITER_IDENTITY" --role=roles/pubsub.publisher</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Generate an event and pull it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud storage buckets create gs://$PROJECT_ID-siem-test --location=us-central1
gcloud pubsub subscriptions pull siem-sub --project=LOG_PROJECT_ID --auto-ack --limit=3 \
  --format="value(message.data)" | head -c 600</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Each message is one log entry in JSON, ready for a SIEM.

5. **Connect a real SIEM.** For Splunk, use the **Pub/Sub to Splunk** Dataflow template or the Splunk add-on. Google SecOps can ingest Google Cloud logs directly, without Pub/Sub.

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud logging sinks delete org-to-siem --organization=ORG_ID --quiet
gcloud pubsub subscriptions delete siem-sub --project=LOG_PROJECT_ID
gcloud pubsub topics delete siem-logs --project=LOG_PROJECT_ID
gcloud storage rm --recursive gs://$PROJECT_ID-siem-test</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Delivery | Near real time through Pub/Sub |
| Format | One JSON log entry per message |
| Filter | Send only what the SIEM needs |
| Unread messages | Kept for 7 days by default |
